item.title: No insurance, no fuel? Supreme Court seeks Centre's plan to stop fuel sales to uninsured vehicles
item.description: The court said such a system would help identify uninsured and unregistered vehicles while encouraging owners to keep their insurance active.

item.title: Kerala schools closed on 5 August in 10 districts as IMD issues Orange Alert

item.description: The missiles reportedly include the Army Tactical Missile System (ATACMS) and the newer Precision Strike Missile (PrSM), two of the US Army's primary surface-to-surface precision weapons.

item.title: Todd Blanche wins crucial Senate committee vote, advances toward confirmation as US attorney general
item.description: Todd Blanche's nomination for US attorney general advances to the full Senate after a key committee vote, following written assurances over a controversial $1.8 billion fund and IRS settlement.

item.title: Delhi SIR: EC revises schedule, announces new date for final voter roll publication | Check details
item.description: Under the updated schedule, electoral officials will examine and decide on claims and objections submitted by voters between August 24 and October 22.

item.title: Michigan Senate primary: Why the Abdul El-Sayed vs Haley Stevens race is crucial for Democrats
item.description: The contest pits progressive candidate Abdul El-Sayed against moderate Representative Haley Stevens in a battle that has become a referendum on issues ranging from US support for Israel to the influence of outside political spending and the party's ideological identity.

item.title: Flipkart seller cancels iPhone 17 Pro Max on discount over ‘price mismatch’— Viral post flags ‘daylight fraud’

item.title: Tax Bill proposes reforms to attract global capital, boost Make in India
item.description: The Taxation and Other Laws (Amendment) Bill seeks to ease rules for offshore funds, cloud firms, REITs, InvITs and electronics manufacturing while strengthening India's investment appeal.

item.description: Several Bollywood stars, including Hrithik Roshan and Aishwarya Rai, are pursuing legal action against unauthorised use of their images and voices.

item.description: People are “shocked and disturbed” that authorities have made no significant progress since Nancy Guthrie was allegedly abducted from her bed at her Catalina Foothills home near Tucson, Arizona, on February 1.

item.title: Delayed Air India flight cost Kerala man his Saudi work trip. Now the airline owes him ₹1.36 lakh
item.description: Kapildev, 42, worked as a driver in Saudi Arabia and had travelled to Kerala in June 2017 to visit his family. On September 10 that year, he was scheduled to return to Saudi Arabia on an Air India itinerary.

item.description: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said negotiations with Tehran were progressing and that a breakthrough could come as early as Tuesday or Wednesday, although Iran publicly denied that direct talks with Washington were taking place.

item.title: Centre plans ₹2,000 crore horticulture clusters to tame food inflation
